name: Lizzy
source: A fiercely competitive track star and the energetic founder of the Adventure Club, having previously stepped down from her roles as Student Council and Debate Club President. Driven by a desire to leave a memorable legacy and an intense need for excellence, she single-handedly orchestrated the senior class's summer camp trip to introduce "controlled danger" to her peers' lives. Despite her overwhelming intensity and occasional sore-loser tendencies, she cares deeply about maintaining her group's cohesion.
